spec: DACS-5 v0.6 §10.5 AWT-1..AWT-8 authenticated reputation-window time
decisionModel: pass may count an in-window job or deterministically exclude an out-of-window job; indeterminate is always non-countable; error/fail cannot satisfy the current profile
inputModel: one post-reconciliation authoritative bundle and all known SR-2 receipt snapshots; evidenceValid/historyDisposition/nativeOrder model binding-authenticated native verification

vectors.name: awt-canonical-finalized-pass
vectors.note: an independently verified finalized receipt supplies the exact bundle clock

vectors.name: awt-backdated-bad-outcome-still-in-window
vectors.note: producer backdating cannot move a bad bundle out when consensus time remains inside

vectors.name: awt-future-dated-good-outcome-still-in-window
vectors.note: producer future-dating cannot move a good bundle when consensus time remains inside

vectors.name: awt-backdated-good-outcome-does-not-enter
vectors.note: an in-window producer time cannot import a bundle whose authenticated time is early

vectors.name: awt-future-dated-good-outcome-does-not-enter-late-window
vectors.note: an in-window producer time cannot import a bundle whose authenticated time is late

vectors.name: awt-large-positive-clock-skew-advisory
vectors.note: large positive finalisedAt skew is audit-only and does not change membership

vectors.name: awt-large-negative-clock-skew-advisory
vectors.note: large negative finalisedAt skew is audit-only and does not change membership

vectors.name: awt-window-start-equality-inclusive
vectors.note: consensus time exactly equal to windowStart is included

vectors.name: awt-window-end-equality-inclusive
vectors.note: consensus time exactly equal to windowEnd is included

vectors.name: awt-observed-at-never-controls-window
vectors.note: observer wall-clock time is ignored even when far outside the window

vectors.name: awt-missing-receipt-indeterminate
vectors.note: no receipt makes the job non-countable without a producer-time fallback

vectors.name: awt-finalized-receipt-missing-timestamp
vectors.note: a finalized receipt without blockRef.timestamp cannot supply the clock

vectors.name: awt-accepted-is-not-clock
vectors.note: durable acceptance has no consensus inclusion clock

vectors.name: awt-included-without-finality-insufficient
vectors.note: included is not enough where the binding has not established finality

vectors.name: awt-indeterminate-finalized-observation-insufficient
vectors.note: an indeterminate snapshot cannot establish finalized time on its own

vectors.name: awt-invalid-native-proof-indeterminate
vectors.note: receipt fields without valid native evidence do not authenticate time

vectors.name: awt-substrate-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose substrate does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-logicaladdress-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose logicalAddress does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-nativeaddress-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose nativeAddress does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-contenthash-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose contentHash does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-writer-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose writer does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-nonce-mismatch-indeterminate
vectors.note: a receipt whose nonce does not bind the exact selected bundle is unusable

vectors.name: awt-replaced-original-without-final-replacement
vectors.note: a replaced transaction is inert until its replacement independently finalizes

vectors.name: awt-finalized-exact-replacement-pass
vectors.note: the exact-content replacement supplies its own finalized inclusion clock

vectors.name: awt-reorg-without-finalized-reentry
vectors.note: a reorged inclusion cannot supply current window time

vectors.name: awt-reorg-then-finalized-reentry-pass
vectors.note: authenticated re-entry followed by finality supplies the new canonical clock

vectors.name: awt-finalized-then-reorg-conflict
vectors.note: a history purporting to reorg a terminal finalized transaction is conflicting

vectors.name: awt-duplicate-identical-finalized-snapshots-collapse
vectors.note: byte-equivalent observations of one finalized event collapse deterministically

vectors.name: awt-two-finalized-transactions-conflict
vectors.note: two surviving finalized transaction identities cannot be cherry-picked

vectors.name: awt-same-transaction-conflicting-blocks
vectors.note: otherwise-valid finalized receipts disagreeing on block identity are unorderable

vectors.name: awt-same-event-conflicting-timestamps
vectors.note: otherwise-valid receipts disagreeing on the event timestamp are unorderable

vectors.name: awt-conflicting-native-order
vectors.note: otherwise-valid receipts disagreeing on native order do not admit min/max selection

vectors.name: awt-explicit-unorderable-history
vectors.note: the binding's unorderable conflict disposition makes the job non-countable

vectors.name: awt-wrong-current-window-basis
vectors.note: the current discriminator accepts only its single finalized-inclusion basis

vectors.name: awt-replay-missing-selected-receipt
vectors.note: replay refuses context that omits the exact receipt used for membership

vectors.name: awt-replay-missing-receipt-history
vectors.note: replay refuses context that omits the receipt history used for conflict checks

vectors.name: awt-replay-substituted-timestamp
vectors.note: replay refuses substitution of a different authenticated timestamp

vectors.name: awt-replay-misordered-history
vectors.note: replay refuses receipt history ordered by observer time instead of native order

vectors.name: awt-current-plus-legacy-discriminator
vectors.note: multiple derivation discriminators are rejected before metrics are used

vectors.name: awt-missing-current-discriminator
vectors.note: a derivation with no discriminator cannot claim current-profile semantics

vectors.name: awt-wrong-current-discriminator-version
vectors.note: an unsupported current-profile version is not reinterpreted as version 1

vectors.name: awt-unknown-derivation-discriminator
vectors.note: an unknown derivation type is rejected rather than structurally downgraded

vectors.name: awt-legacy-is-not-current
vectors.note: a released derivation cannot satisfy a current-profile request

vectors.name: awt-legacy-producer-time-is-not-era-evidence
vectors.note: computedAt and finalisedAt cannot authenticate a pre-current production era

vectors.name: awt-legacy-authenticated-era-historical-only
vectors.note: authenticated profile pinning may admit a legacy receipt only as historical/partial
